verdict.rationale: Docs mention that businesses can 'submit documents, manage signers, and automate notarization workflows' with AI-detected signature fields, implying some multi-signer capability, but there is no evidence of routing logic (sequential/parallel signing order) or explicit multi-recipient e-signature flows — the core product is notarization, not a dedicated e-signature platform. Missing for 10: explicit multi-recipient routing/sequencing documentation, evidence of a standalone e-signature (non-notarized) flow, and independent confirmation of the 'manage signers' feature in practice.
